before: The numbered list showed three posts; the user said yes to all three.

steps.why: One call for every yes. Read each item's result, not only the overall one.

Post 2's item came back with error_code client_review_pending ("This post is awaiting client sign-off"): an open client review blocks the team's approve. On a brand that requires client sign-off, client_signoff.state reads waiting_on_client: it was sent, and the client, or a required reviewer, hasn't approved yet. On a brand without that rule it reads not_required even while the client review is open.
approve-many-posts returns no times, and Bolta picked them (approve_only), so read where 1 and 3 landed before saying any time. Times come back in UTC: show them in the brand clock.

say: Approved 1 and 3: they go out Tuesday 9 am and Thursday 9 am on LinkedIn. 2 is with the client. When every reviewer it needs says yes, it goes out at the time they were shown if that's still ahead; otherwise at its next open time. Nothing to do here.
never: Retrying, deleting or publishing post 2 to get round the client.
Saying one client's yes is enough when the request has required reviewers.
